summary.text: Robyn Gabel is a Democratic Illinois state representative who has represented District 18 since 2010 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She has served as House Majority Leader since 2023 and previously led the Illinois Maternal and Child Health Coalition.

paragraphs.text: Robyn Gabel was born in Chicago and earned a B.A. in anthropology from Beloit College in 1975, an M.P.H. in public health from the University of Illinois in 1979, and an M.J. in health law from Loyola University Chicago.

Her professional experience includes working as a legislative aide to Alderman Luis Gutierrez, as training coordinator for Planned Parenthood from 1979 to 1980, as co-director of the Chicago Women's Health Center from 1980 to 1987, and as executive director of the Illinois Maternal and Child Health Coalition from 1988 to 2010.
Gabel has served in the Illinois House since 2010 and began serving as House Majority Leader in 2023.
In a 2020 Ballotpedia survey, she said she is from Evanston and listed good government and protecting the environment among her key campaign messages.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on March 17, 2026.
